# ExampleCLI release notes

## v4.4.0

[https://github.com/example-vendor/example-cli/releases/tag/v4.4.0](https://github.com/example-vendor/example-cli/releases/tag/v4.4.0)

### Bug Fixes

- **hooks:** honor `timeout` for SessionStart hooks, fixes #88
- **config:** reject unknown top-level keys instead of ignoring them, closes #91
- **windows:** handle network drive paths in `--config`

### Features

- **ui:** add a compact status line
